tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind everything. Warm paper in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards (link cards, folder list, sheets). Sits on bg without a border in light; a hairline line in dark.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Filled inputs, inactive chips, pressed rows, skeletons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and card outlines. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that need 3:1 (radio rings, outlined buttons). 3.05:1 on surface-2 light, 3.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: URL paths, hints, counts, placeholders. 5.4:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: violet-600
tokens.usage: Brand violet, from the chain icon. Fills the active folder chip and primary buttons; text on it is on-violet.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on violet-600 (6.2:1 light, 5.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal background for icon buttons, favicon tiles and selected rows.

tokens.name: violet-text
tokens.usage: Violet used as text or icon: tonal button icons, links, focus ring. 6.4:1 on violet-soft.

tokens.name: mint-400
tokens.usage: The save action: the round submit on the add-link bar, success toasts. Carried over from the old submit button. Always with on-mint text; never as text.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on mint-400 (9.0:1).

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Success background (copied, saved).

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Mint used as text or icon on surface or mint-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete actions and errors. Text on a danger fill is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (5.2:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a destructive row in a sheet and of error toasts.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast pill: inverted ink so it reads over any content.

tokens.name: toast-ink
tokens.usage: Text on toast-bg.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles under the app bar.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Create a folder to better organize your links.

styles.name: url
styles.usage: URL path under the domain in a link card; single line, ellipsis.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked link cards' actions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between link cards; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding on mobile; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between screen sections (app bar, tabs, list).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of sign-in, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Favicon tile, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons in sheets, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Link cards, folder list group.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; the add-link bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, icon buttons, the round submit, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Link cards and list groups in light theme; dark relies on the line hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating add-link bar, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: icon buttons, chips' hit area, rows.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Height of the add-link bar and the app bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on larger screens (matches the current sm:max-w-xl).
